parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses both error targets: (1) it removes the unsupported inference that authors can infer exactly how to approach the revision, replacing it with an accurate statement that the comment poses broad open questions without implementation details; and (2) it corrects the rubric misapplication by noting the implicit action is vague on implementation, matching a lower rubric level rather than the previously claimed level 4. The rationale preserves the unrelated correct reasoning about the comment containing two questions and the implicit nature of the suggested action. It avoids stating a numeric final score or gold label directly, instead describing the band qualitatively.
